title: A Virtual Member of a Community of Practice for the Society of Petroleum Engineers: From Prototype to Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2608.19199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We describe the evolution of a virtual assistant, called ATHENA, designed to support the capture, retrieval, and dissemination of knowledge for members of a Community of Practice (CoP) related to the Oil and Gas sector. An evaluation of a first prototype involving 75 professionals from the Society of Petroleum Engineering (SPE) showed that ATHENA dramatically improved both their productivity and performance equality on a set of realistic well-planning tasks compare to their use of a state-of-the-art RAG baseline system. However, the evaluation also identified areas for improvement. This paper describes technical advances to our first prototype in the areas of multi-document retrieval, support for answer validation, and more focused proactive dissemination. translated_title: 石油工程师协会实践社区中的虚拟成员：从原型到部署
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一个名为ATHENA的虚拟助手的演变过程，该助手旨在支持石油和天然气领域实践社区（CoP）成员的知识捕获、检索和传播。对涉及石油工程协会（SPE）75名专业人士的首个原型的评估显示，与使用最先进的RAG基线系统相比，ATHENA在一组现实井规划任务中显著提高了他们的生产力和绩效均等性。然而，评估也指出了需要改进的领域。本文描述了我们对首个原型在多文档检索、答案验证支持以及更聚焦的主动传播方面的技术进展。评估结果表明，这种增强版的ATHENA在完成与井规划相关的知识密集型任务方面，提供了比最先进基线系统更好的支持。
tldr: 本文介绍了ATHENA虚拟助手的升级版，通过改进多文档检索、答案验证和主动传播，显著提升了石油工程师在井规划任务中的知识支持效率和绩效。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an enhanced version of the ATHENA virtual assistant, which improves multi-document retrieval, answer validation, and proactive dissemination, significantly boosting knowledge support and performance for petroleum engineers in well-planning tasks.
